dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: This teapot is so much bigger on the inside... I can't believe it.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: #Thank you for inviting me, {NICKNAME}. It's always nice to broaden one's horizons!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: I find it quite splendid.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: In my line of work, I'm lucky if I get to spend a couple of months out of the whole year in such comfortable surroundings.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like your working conditions must be pretty harsh!

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: I can certainly think of several examples that fit that description. There was the time we had to dive into icy water during the dead of winter to intercept some smuggling ships.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Or, when we carried out a search for several days straight with no sleep to apprehend a fugitive. Luckily, the thick soles on our shoes make them extremely durable.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Then, of course, there was also the time during the summer when we had to hide ourselves in some bushes along a river while we waited to ambush a suspect.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: There were a lot of poisonous insects around the river at that time of year with bites that can be quite deadly. But most insect repellants have a pungent odor that, if used, would have exposed our position.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: So, all I could do was advise the members of my Platoon to keep their skin covered and remain in position until the suspect emerged and began to trade the stolen goods for Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: In the end, we managed to apprehend the suspect and the goods. But, a few members of my platoon passed out from heatstroke and were indisposed for quite some time.

choices.text: I'm getting uncomfortable just thinking about all of that...

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Uncomfortable is part of the job. But we're used to it. After all, ensuring peace for the citizens of Fontaine is no small matter.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: But... *sigh* The number of Gardes that have been injured in the line of duty has been increasing lately...

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: I should submit a request to the Maison Gardiennage to increase compensation for injured Gardes.

choices.text: Did you come out of all of that unscathed, Chevreuse?

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: That's a given. I am the captain, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Okay. Due to confidentiality restrictions, I can't share any specific case details with you.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: But I can tell you a story about the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Some time ago, we lost one of the members of our platoon. He sacrificed himself while carrying out an important mission.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: We arranged a funeral service for him and turned his effects over to his family.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: The only thing we held onto was the cap from his uniform. It's a tradition. If his son decided to join the Gardes in the future, we would pass the cap down to him.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: One day, after everything was settled, I saw a group of people gathered outside. I rushed over, thinking there was someone causing a disturbance.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who was it? His son?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: It was. The boy grabbed one of my Gardes by the sleeve and asked, "Have you seen my daddy?"

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: He couldn't describe his father's appearance beyond the fact that he was "big and tall." The boy just kept repeating his father's name over and over again, but there was little we could say in return.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: We all knew that his father had long been part of covert operations for the Special Patrol and hadn't been able to return home after the birth of his son.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: But there was something we didn't know. In order to protect his cover, he hadn't left behind a single picture of himself, even for his family.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: The boy learned from his mother that his father was an "Honored Garde of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol."

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: But, I would imagine the word "honor" meant very little to him, and that it was even harder to comprehend that his father "was never coming back."

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: In the end, we escorted the boy home, and each member of my platoon left him with a gift.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Some gave him a pocket watch, a pen, or a badge.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What about you?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: I gave him a copy of my favorite novel.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: I hope that he can be like the hero in that novel one day and have the resolve to follow his own path.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Whether he makes the choice to don his father's cap or follow a path that leads him away from the Gardes...

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: My only wish is that he feels proud of his father all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: It's rare that I get the chance to relax like this.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Also... I've been meaning to ask whether you would be willing to assist me with some missions. With your help, I imagine the perpetrators will practically catch themselves!

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: There's certainly a chance we may need to resort to violence. But, the readiness of your answer seems to suggest that you're quite used to that sort of thing.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Don't worry. That wasn't an accusation.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Sometimes, it's the only "language" people will understand. If anybody, I know that best of all.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: So, do we have an agreement?

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: For missions that require infiltration and surveillance, I was thinking that this teapot might make good cover.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: But now I see that entering and exiting are rather complicated. So how about this... I bring the teapot on the mission with you inside as backup.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: When you hear me tap on the side of the teapot, you jump out, and we take down the perpetrators together.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: "Captain of the Special Security and Surveillance TEAPOT-rol" does have a certain ring to it. It's decided then!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sorry, I can't give the teapot to you...

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: I suppose I'll have to train you to be a proper Garde then. If you can handle it, that is.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: I think you'll find me to be quite generous, especially when it comes to my friends.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Also, in case it sweetens the deal... if the food at the Victory Feast isn't to your taste, I'd be happy to share some of my more... criminally delicious snacks with you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Morning, Chevreuse!

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Good morning! I just finished patrolling the area and can confirm the perimeter is secure.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: But, it appears there isn't any exercise equipment here. I suppose I'll have to suspend my morning strength training for today.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Chevreuse!

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: #Get some rest, {NICKNAME}! I'm going make a few more rounds on patrol to walk off some... recent transgressions of the food variety.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: This makes me feel like I'm back in the dorms at the Special Patrol headquarters.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: All that's missing is the clothes hanging on the backs of the chairs, the half-empty coffee cups...

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: And of course, all my teammates, looking ready to pass out after an intense day.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: You know, I've sent quite a few people to the Fortress of Meropide.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Since it's a place of second chances... I hope they make the most of it and take the opportunity to redeem themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: Most important of all, I hope they learn right from wrong, and turn away from crime in the future.
